meta.name: TECNOFEUDO SURVEILLANCE
meta.brief: Vigilância como arquitetura: a câmera vê, o sistema cobre o mundo com placas sólidas e só abre furos onde detecta um corpo. Contenção, medição, ordem.

contract.concept: Vigilância como arquitetura: a câmera vê, o sistema cobre o mundo com placas sólidas e só abre furos onde detecta um corpo. Contenção, medição, ordem.
contract.audienceEffect: O público deve sentir Vigilância como arquitetura: a câmera vê, o sistema cobre o mundo com placas sólidas e só abre furos
contract.visualLanguage: Concept order: verbs compress, assemble, converge, fold; motifs squeeze, locking parts, vanishing point, crease; one dominant figure per composition over a quiet ground.
contract.formLanguage: Forms follow the hero generator of each composition; the structure layer keeps one module and one grid.
contract.materialLanguage: Light on a dark ground: dense matte metal; tiles, parts.
contract.colorLogic: analogous scheme, OKLCH hue 250 (cold steel and signal blue); one accent used for events only.
contract.spatialLogic: Canvas 3840x1080 (led); the hero sits on the focal zone, structure on the grid, information at the edge.
contract.motionLanguage: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.8064, 1% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 8 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py). Animation IR archetypes: surge, pulse, settle, surge (a slow build once per bar that drops at the end of the bar).
contract.typographyLanguage: Uppercase, one family; text only when the brief supplies exact words.
contract.temporalArc: calm, compress, hold, break, release; slow build to the peak; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows calm, compress, hold, break.
contract.loopGrammar: cyclic: the loop closes on whole bars and every layer moves in whole cycles
contract.technicalStrategy: Generated without AI by brief_to_project.py from the structured brief; native pixels, deterministic seed, engine generators only.
contract.forbiddenShortcuts: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias
contract.focalEvent: A placa sólida vermelha abre furos exatamente onde o blob é detectado, e o contador de alvos salta
contract.releaseZone: The ground field and the empty third of the frame; no layer fills it.
contract.banned: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias

artBible.thesis: Vigilância como arquitetura: a câmera vê, o sistema cobre o mundo com placas sólidas e só abre furos onde detecta um corpo. Contenção, medição, ordem.
artBible.material: Light on a dark ground (industrial, minimal, glitch); dense matte metal; tiles, parts; no fake materials, no gradients that pretend to be objects.
artBible.space: Read from far away: heavy strokes, large forms, the hero on the focal third, information at the edge.
artBible.motion: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.8064, 1% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 8 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py). Animation IR archetypes: surge, pulse, settle, surge (a slow build once per bar that drops at the end of the bar).
artBible.dramaturgy: calm, compress, hold, break, release; slow build to the peak; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows calm, compress, hold, break. Tension: balanced; one dominant figure per composition; the ground field is the release.
artBible.color: analogous scheme, OKLCH hue 250 (cold steel and signal blue); one accent used for events only.
artBible.typography: No text unless the brief supplies exact words; if added: uppercase, one family, three sizes at most.
artBible.audio: Strategy structural: the music drives structure and scale, never every hit.
artBible.banned: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias
